rule: Java / Kotlin / C# / Groovy / Scala: package/namespace-qualified: `com.x.C#m`; an external type is qualified through its explicit import. | Method: `Type#member`. | `self.m()` / `this.m()` / a bare call to a member of the enclosing type → `Type#m`. | Overloads share one ID.
notes: File-scoped `namespace App;` qualifies every type. Both Add overloads are App.Calculator#Add. Bare Add(...) and this.Twice(...) are members of the enclosing type. System.Console.WriteLine is written fully qualified, so the external type is System.Console (medium: not defined in the scan). Static calls on a scanned class (MathUtil.Square) are Type#m, high. All calls of methods use call_type method.
